host_storage_capacity: 1.7 TB NVMe SSD (OS), 14 TB NVMe SSD (local scratch)
host_network_card_count: 4x NVIDIA ConnectX-8, 1x NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU (400Gb/s per port)
accelerator_interconnect: 5th Gen NVLink, 18 links x 53.125 GB/s per GPU, all-to-all
accelerator_interconnect_topology: Direct all-to-all NVLink among the 4 GPUs (no NVLink Switch)
other_software_stack: CUDA 13.0, NVIDIA Driver 580.173.02, TensorRT-LLM 1.3.0rc14, vLLM (CentML) 0.20.2rc1.dev2091+g2e1040b7e, NVIDIA Dynamo, NVIDIA inference-endpoints client 0.1.0, Slurm 23.11.4 + Pyxis 0.24.0 + Enroot 3.5.0
hw_notes: Single GB300 NVL4 node (Supermicro PIO-FRU-121GL-NB3-LCC-R1): 2x NVIDIA Grace CPU (72 cores each) + 4x NVIDIA GB300 288GB HBM3e, 1400W TGP per GPU, direct all-to-all 5th-gen NVLink (no NVLink Switch). GPU HBM is exposed as coherent NUMA memory alongside the 960GB of Grace LPDDR5X.
sw_notes: GPT-OSS-120B served with TensorRT-LLM (trtllm-serve, in-flight batching) as 4 data-parallel replicas (one GPU per replica) behind the MLPerf LoadGen harness. Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B served with vLLM + NVIDIA Dynamo as 4 data-parallel replicas (TP=1, one GPU per replica) and benchmarked with the NVIDIA/MLCommons inference-endpoints client; endpoint result format. Both workflows orchestrated by nv-sflow on Slurm with Pyxis/Enroot containers.
